manifest.lr_search: flat: 13 rates; ZFO: 7 rates; same endpoints; flat adds geometric midpoints
manifest.work_proxy: training forwards + 2 * backwards; excludes monitoring; not FLOPs
manifest.muon: native torch Muon, every 2D tensor incl. augmented bias columns; rank-one matrices on vector tasks
manifest.selection: lowest mean final validation across tuning seeds, all seeds must finish; ties choose smaller LR

tasks.title: Isotropic quadratic
tasks.description: A well-scaled convex control. A tuned constant step already works well; extra probes can be pure overhead.

tasks.title: Ill-conditioned least squares
tasks.description: A rotated linear system with condition number 10,000 in its Hessian. Tests scale sensitivity without nonconvexity.

tasks.title: Exponential curve fitting
tasks.description: Fit amplitude, decay, and offset from a poor initial guess. Rapid curvature changes challenge a local polynomial or rational model.

tasks.title: Logistic regression
tasks.description: Anisotropic features and stochastic binary labels. Tune on validation cross-entropy; report untouched test cross-entropy and accuracy.

tasks.title: Low-rank matrix factorization
tasks.description: Recover a rank-three matrix with two trainable factors. A nonconvex problem with genuine matrix geometry for Muon.

tasks.title: Rosenbrock valley
tasks.description: A curved narrow valley with seed-perturbed starts. Local step selection cannot repair a poorly aligned direction.

tasks.title: Beale surface
tasks.description: A two-variable nonlinear least-squares landscape. Includes seed-perturbed difficult starts and unstable learning rates.

tasks.title: Rastrigin landscape
tasks.description: Many local minima. Good local descent does not guarantee global progress; a deliberate limitation test.

tasks.title: Minibatch noisy regression
tasks.description: Noisy targets and batches of sixteen. Fixed-batch probes are coherent but may pick steps that generalize poorly to the next batch.

tasks.title: Two moons · tanh MLP
tasks.description: Nonlinear classification with a smooth 16-unit network, finite samples, and held-out validation/test data.

tasks.title: XOR · ReLU MLP
tasks.description: A small piecewise-linear network crosses activation boundaries. The loss need not match a smooth Taylor model along the whole search interval.

tasks.title: Moons · 30% label noise
tasks.description: A tanh classifier trained on corrupted labels in minibatches. Validation and test labels remain clean to expose overfitting.
